title: Shoplifter Tries To Run From The Police
description:
On June 7, 2021, a man who repeatedly robbed the Gloucester Township Target was arrested in the process of another attempted shoplifting incident. He was charged with fourth-degree resisting by flight, third-degree possession of CDS, and criminal trespass.
